stable_traits.physical_traits: squat and stocky, barely tall enough to look through cross-hatched bars

stable_traits.personality: sullen, never speaks anymore, getting worse over time

characters.notes: The other dungeon guard with Changu. Sharpens dagger with stone, never stopped during the chapter. Used to speak, now silent.
Referenced by Padan Fain: 'Mordeth knows more than all of you. Mordeth knows.' The evil from Shadar Logoth that tainted Mat's dagger.

appearances.whereabouts: Throughout Fal Dara keep: attempting to leave via sally gate, Dog Gate, Carters' Gate; wandering storerooms, corridors, kitchen, servants' apartments, armorer's forge and yard, woodyard; finally led by Egwene to the dungeon
appearances.notable_actions: Tries repeatedly to find a way out of the keep to escape before the Amyrlin Seat finds him. Finds all gates barred. Deliberately drives away Mat, Perrin, and Loial to protect them from himself. Argues with Egwene. Senses an unseen watcher following him through empty areas of the keep. Eventually agrees to hide in the dungeon with Padan Fain to avoid the Amyrlin.
appearances.demeanor: Frightened, desperate, paranoid about being watched, angry and self-isolating as a defense mechanism, torn between wanting to protect friends and pushing them away

appearances.whereabouts: Guard at the sally gate
appearances.notable_actions: Jokes with Rand about his bow. Explains that no one may leave without a written pass because the gates have been barred on Lord Agelmar's orders (passed through Uno). Friendly but will not let Rand pass.
appearances.demeanor: Easygoing, friendly, likes Rand but duty-bound

appearances.whereabouts: Guard at the sally gate with Ragan
appearances.notable_actions: Questions Rand's bow, says it's no good from a horse. Refuses to let Rand leave. Eyes Rand's packs suspiciously. Stares at Rand as he leaves.
appearances.demeanor: Sour, suspicious, hostile to outlanders, unblinking and intense

appearances.whereabouts: Not present in scenes; mentioned as having passed orders
appearances.notable_actions: Passed the order to bar the gates from Lord Agelmar to the guards. Has a reputation for sharp tongue.

appearances.whereabouts: Storeroom watching men gamble; later follows Rand through corridors
appearances.notable_actions: Watches the dice game, discusses ta'veren and the Wheel with Mat despite Mat's protests. Explains he doesn't know a way out of Fal Dara because it was built by men, not Ogier. Driven away by Rand's harsh words about trees and groves.
appearances.demeanor: Thoughtful, curious, talks too much, hurt by Rand's rejection but becomes stiffly angry

appearances.whereabouts: Storeroom gambling with dice; leaves with Perrin
appearances.notable_actions: Winning at dice, touches his coat where the dagger is hidden. Quotes sayings about Aes Sedai. Argues with Rand about going to Tar Valon. Hurt by Rand's rejection but leaves with Perrin when Rand drives them away.
appearances.demeanor: Half-smiling as if seeing something funny, defensive about the dagger and Aes Sedai, hurt and cold after Rand's speech

appearances.whereabouts: Storeroom with Mat and Loial; leaves with Mat
appearances.notable_actions: Keeps eyes down most of the time. Briefly lifts his yellow eyes to look at Rand. Tries to mediate between Rand and Mat. Hurt by Rand's rejection. Agrees to leave with Mat.
appearances.demeanor: Withdrawn, eyes down, shoulders sagging, deeply hurt by Rand's words, isolated even among friends

appearances.whereabouts: Not present in scenes; in women's apartments
appearances.notable_actions: Referenced as having had all the Two Rivers clothes burned and replaced. Teaching Egwene. Questions Padan Fain (has him brought to her, not going to dungeon herself). Has not questioned Fain much for weeks.

appearances.whereabouts: Searching storerooms for Rand; dungeon visiting Padan Fain
appearances.notable_actions: Searches for Rand after Mat, Perrin and Loial tell her what happened. Tackles Rand and sits on him to make him listen. Threatens to set his breeches on fire and accidentally flares a torch. Convinces Rand to hide in the dungeon. Takes him to visit Padan Fain. Plans to hide him in the women's apartments.
appearances.demeanor: Determined, managing, takes charge, uses Moiraine and Nynaeve's manner, stubborn, protective of Rand despite his protests

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; mentioned as visiting dungeon
appearances.notable_actions: Visits Padan Fain in the dungeon regularly

appearances.whereabouts: Not present in scenes
appearances.notable_actions: Previously warned Rand that with the Amyrlin Seat present, it would be better if Rand were gone a week

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; presumably with the Amyrlin Seat
appearances.notable_actions: Issued order to bar all gates with no one to leave without written pass. Has Rand at his table normally.

appearances.whereabouts: In her chambers in the women's apartments after the Welcome ceremony
appearances.notable_actions: Arrived at Fal Dara with her party. Received the Shienaran Welcome. Her presence caused the gates to be barred and Rand to attempt to flee.

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; mentioned
appearances.notable_actions: Had all the Two Rivers clothes burned and replaced. Will probably come to collect the clothes Mat and Perrin are still wearing.

appearances.whereabouts: Cell at the end of the dungeon
appearances.notable_actions: Sits on cot waiting as if expecting visitors. Points at Rand in the darkness and says Rand cannot hide from him or 'them.' Chants a rhyme about freedom and death. Stares at an angle up into darkness (toward women's apartments where Amyrlin and Moiraine are). Chuckles and references Mordeth. Says 'the battle's never done' and 'they're coming for me, and they're coming for you.'
appearances.demeanor: Much worse than usual - mad, threatening, staring at nothing, chuckling at unseen things, cryptically menacing

appearances.whereabouts: Guard station at dungeon entrance
appearances.notable_actions: Opens door reluctantly for Egwene and Rand. Mocks Rand for being tall and well-dressed. Makes taunting comments about the 'Darkfriend friend.' Provides lamp and unlocks inner door. Much ruder and meaner than on previous visits according to Egwene.
appearances.demeanor: Mocking, rude, sullen, meaner than before, suspicious

appearances.whereabouts: Guard station at dungeon entrance
appearances.notable_actions: Sharpens dagger continuously with stone. Never looks up. Never speaks. Used to speak but doesn't anymore according to Egwene.
appearances.demeanor: Silent, sullen, withdrawn, worse over time

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; back in Two Rivers
appearances.notable_actions: Referenced by Mat as someone who tells tall tales in the Winespring Inn

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; fate unknown
appearances.notable_actions: Referenced for his words about gentled men dying soon after, stopping wanting to live

appearances.whereabouts: Not physically present; invoked by Padan Fain
appearances.notable_actions: Referenced by Fain: 'Mordeth knows more than all of you. Mordeth knows.'
alliances_shown: associated with the evil of Shadar Logoth

relationships.description: Childhood friends from Two Rivers, but Rand deliberately drives Mat away to protect him from being near Rand when he becomes dangerous
Childhood friends from Two Rivers, but Rand deliberately drives Perrin away to protect him, causing visible hurt
Friends and traveling companions, but Rand deliberately drives Loial away with harsh words about Ogier trees and groves
Grew up thinking they would marry. Egwene still protective and managing toward Rand. Relationship strained by Rand's secret and his isolation.
Lan trains Rand with the sword and warned him about the Amyrlin Seat
Moiraine knows Rand can channel. Rand fears her but acknowledges she hasn't hurt him yet. Complex relationship of knowledge and fear.
Moiraine holds the Warder bond with Lan as her Warder
Moiraine is teaching Egwene, who is taking on Moiraine's manner
Friends from Two Rivers, leave together when Rand drives them away
Egwene visits Fain regularly in the dungeon to talk about home and Two Rivers people. She sees him as becoming more like his old self sometimes.
Nynaeve visits Fain in the dungeon regularly
Fain tracked Rand for the Shadow, brought Trollocs to hunt him. Now imprisoned, he claims to sense Rand and says 'they' are coming for both of them.
Fellow guards at the sally gate, though with different attitudes toward Rand
Fellow dungeon guards, both growing meaner and more sullen over time
Lord Agelmar gives orders through Uno to the guards
